## About
Hanna's Auto Care Center is a family business at 715 Easy St in Garland. We handle complete auto repair, from a simple oil change to rebuilding engines and transmissions, plus body damage and major collision repair.
Our mechanics are highly skilled with years of experience, and most of all they love cars and care about yours. We know car repair is not fun or convenient, so we try to make the process as easy as we can. You may not be related to us, but we want you to feel like family.
We also like helping people in our community learn something new through our Success Learning Vehicle, a hands-on training project. Bring your car in for an inspection and see how we work.

## Services
- Tune-ups and timing belts: Tune-ups and timing belts on the factory recommended schedule to keep your car healthy and in top condition.
- Engine and transmission repair: Engine and transmission work on import and domestic cars, including full rebuilds.
- Collision and body repair: Our body shop handles everything from body damage to major collision repair.
- Brakes, A/C, shocks and struts: Brake work, A/C repair, shocks, struts and mufflers.
- Electrical and computer diagnostics: We track down electrical problems and check engine issues with computer diagnostics.
- Towing: We can arrange towing to get your vehicle to the shop. Call us for details.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on imports as well as domestic cars?
A: Yes. We work on import and domestic cars, from basic maintenance to major repairs.

Q: Can I drop my car off after hours?
A: Yes. We have a key drop box for after hours service.

Q: Do you work on diesel trucks?
A: We have. One customer had their diesel truck towed to us after it broke down, and we found and fixed the root of the problem.
